name: Sisay
description: Sisay is the Zhalfirin captain of the skyship Weatherlight, known for seeking the Legacy to destroy the Lord of the Wastes and as the ancestor of Shanna.

"Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

summary.text: Sisay is the Zhalfirin captain of the skyship Weatherlight, known for seeking the Legacy to destroy the Lord of the Wastes and as the ancestor of Shanna.

citations.text: "Sisay". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Phyrexians raided Sisay's village and orphaned her, and she later set out to gather the Legacy, knowing only that it could kill the Lord of the Wastes, Yawgmoth.

citations.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She inherited the Weatherlight after the Zhalfirin family that held it was killed, and her crew grew to include Tahngarth, who became first mate, and later Gerrard and others shaped by the bloodline project.

citations.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The Phyrexian servant Starke betrayed Sisay and captured her and the Legacy, delivering her to Volrath's Stronghold on Rath to lure Gerrard there.

citations.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Abduction of Sisay", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Abduction of Sisay", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Gerrard led the Weatherlight to Rath, freed Sisay and retook the Legacy, and the ship then crashed on Mercadia, where Sisay gathered artifacts to repair it and helped lead the oppressed peoples to a change of regime.

citations.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: When the Phyrexian Invasion began she helmed the Weatherlight in many battles until it crashed when the Primeval Dragons attacked, and she crashed the Predator into Crovax's stronghold.

citations.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
Hull Breach (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Gerrard, Urza and Karn merged to complete the Legacy and defeat Yawgmoth, and the Weatherlight sank near Urborg, so Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee were given a new vessel named Victory.

citations.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: Sisay is spoken of in later stories as a late former captain and as Shanna's ancestor, whom Jhoira knew; her last recorded act is sailing the Victory a year after the Invasion.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.
"Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.
"Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay recalls throwing fruit to drakes along the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: "We threw dried fruit to the drakes that rode the air, streaming along the *Weatherlight'*s side as we sailed amidst the clouds."

citation.text: Teferi's Drake (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay recalls angels sing their swords' names with each strike.
timeline.quote: "My mother once told me angels sing their swords' names with each strike."

citation.text: Archangel (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay tells of a ring giving friends in other worlds.
timeline.quote: "With this ring, you have friends in worlds you've never heard of."

citation.text: Sisay's Ring (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay and the Weatherlight land before Asmira and Rashida's party.
timeline.quote: Sisay and her flying galleon, the Weatherlight , landed before them.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Shocking Visions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard returns to the Weatherlight as captain in Sisay's absence after serving in the Benalish army.
timeline.quote: Now, after serving nobly in the Benalish army, he has returned to the *Weatherlight* to serve as captain in Sisay's absence

citation.text: Gerrard (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay undertakes a quest for the Legacy and continues it when Gerrard abandons it.
timeline.quote: She continued this quest even when Gerrard, heir to the Legacy, chose to abandon it.

citation.text: Sisay (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax joins the Weatherlight crew to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: joining the crew of the *Weatherlight* as they seek to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.

citation.text: Crovax (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay declares the Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed.
timeline.quote: "The Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed; I am bound to this destiny by the chains of fate. If only Gerrard would see his part."

citation.text: Mana Chains (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Rofellos and Mirri join Sisay's Weatherlight crew after Gerrard loses a wager.
timeline.quote: with Gerrard having lost a tavern wager over a contest of knife-throwing against her

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn is tricked into killing an innocent and frozen by the Touchstone; reactivated by Gerrard, he vows never to take a life.
timeline.quote: Karn took a vow of pacifism, swearing never again to take a life.

citation.text: "Karn", section "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Three years later Gerrard asks Mirri to be his Lieutenant and she rejoins the crew to rescue Captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Mirri both were instrumental in stopping the rampaging monster

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians raid Sisay's village, orphaning her.
timeline.quote: Sisay was orphaned at a young age when they raided her village.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay sets out to gather the Legacy, knowing only that it can kill the Lord of the Wastes, Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Sisay set out to gather the Legacy.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Captured by Suq'Atan slavers, Sisay is rescued by the crew of the Burning Vengeance, burns her captor to death and joins the crew, training under Murad.
timeline.quote: She trained under Captain Murad until she became a full-fledged sailor

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay becomes a minor celebrity during the Mirage Wars, spying on enemy positions for the Zhalfirin armies.
timeline.quote: She became a minor celebrity during the Mirage Wars

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A volcanic dragon forces her ship to land near the Talruum Mountains, where Tahngarth fights as her champion and joins her crew.
timeline.quote: He joined her crew and quickly proved himself.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew recovers the Juju Bubble in the Adarkar Wastes; Meida is killed and Tahngarth becomes first mate.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth later took her place as first mate.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay's crew joins Asmira and Rashida Scalebane to free Mangara.
timeline.quote: Together, they freed Mangara

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay meets Gerrard and others influenced by the bloodline project, who join the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: Among them Gerrard , the true heir to the Legacy.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza entrusts the ship to a Zhalfirin family; Sisay inherits it after the family is killed by the Lord of the Wastes.
timeline.quote: Sisay inherited the ship from her family after they were mysteriously killed by the Lord of the Wastes .

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in the Talruum Mountains; Tahngarth fights as Sisay's champion, defeats Ghentoth and joins her crew.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth offered to fight as Sisay's champion and proved himself by defeating Ghentoth.

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Meida is killed in the Adarkar Wastes, Tahngarth becomes Sisay's first mate.
timeline.quote: he took her place as Sisay's first mate

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Captain Sisay is kidnapped and the crew must travel to Rath to save her.
timeline.quote: captain Sisay has been kidnapped, and they have to travel to the plane of Rath to save her

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay says angering the gods turns clouds against you.
timeline.quote: "You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you."

citation.text: Cloud Elemental (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard learns Starke betrayed the Phyrexians and had been feeding Sisay information about the Legacy.
timeline.quote: it was none other than Starke who had betrayed his masters and had supplied Sisay with information about the Legacy

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke, a servant of the Phyrexians, betrays Sisay and captures her and the Legacy.
timeline.quote: Sisay happily gathered them, only to be betrayed.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leads Weatherlight to Rath, frees Sisay and retakes the Legacy from Volrath.
timeline.quote: where they freed Sisay and retook the Legacy from Volrath

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight crashes on Mercadia, where Sisay gathers artifacts to repair the ship and leads the oppressed peoples to a change of regime.
timeline.quote: she led the oppressed peoples of the plane to a successful shift in regime

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath uses the hive to guard the Legacy and attack the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: Volrath used the hive to guard the Legacy and to attack Weatherlight and her crew on their quest to retake those artifacts and their captain, Sisay .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth convinces Gerrard to rejoin the crew after Sisay is taken to Rath.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth convinced Gerrard to rejoin the crew to help his friends

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth is mutated by the Phyrexians under Volrath, then freed before the process completes; he helps free Sisay and the crew escapes to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth had been mutated by the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath has Sisay abducted to lure the Weatherlight to Rath, ambushes it, and captures Tahngarth, Karn and the Legacy artifacts; Gerrard falls over Skyshroud Forest.
timeline.quote: He organized the abduction of Sisay to lure Weatherlight to Rath

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills a shapeshifted Volrath decoy; the real Volrath, in Takara's form, stows away on the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Volrath had shapeshifted into the form of Takara, which enabled him to stow away aboard Weatherlight as it fled the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay, injured, asks about her ship and Gerrard assures her it is intact.
timeline.quote: Intact," Gerrard reassured her

citation.text: Fugue (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew, having rescued Sisay and pieces of the Legacy, must retreat through Volrath's Stronghold to the portal off Rath.
timeline.quote: The crew of the Weatherlight has rescued Captain Sisay and the pieces of the Legacy

citation.text: "Exodus", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay recruits Gerrard and his friends as Weatherlight crew after a knife-throwing contest.
timeline.quote: recruited the companions as crew on the Weatherlight as payment for a bet

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke betrays Sisay to Volrath to lure Gerrard to Rath and free his daughter.
timeline.quote: he betrayed Sisay to Volrath and then begged the remaining crew to find Gerrard and rescue him

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn is reactivated by Gerrard, in flashback.
timeline.quote: Sometime later, he felt joy again as Gerrard reactivated him

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Karn's Tale" ( J. Robert King )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rescue party frees Karn and Tahngarth but finds only a shapeshifter in place of Sisay.
timeline.quote: It turned out to be a shapeshifter, however

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth commandeers an ornithopter to try to pick up Gerrard.
timeline.quote: the minotaur jumps aboard the ornithopter and takes control of it

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Tahngarth kill Volrath, whose body shapeshifts.
timeline.quote: The two killed Volrath, but the body shapeshifted into one of Volrath's experiments.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians launch a preemptive strike on Bloodline sites, killing thousands including Sisay's parents and Clan Capashen.
timeline.quote: launched a preemptive strike against sites where the Bloodline project was taking place, killing thousands of people

citation.text: "Metathran", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4195 AR Sisay and Tahngarth find the Juju Bubble in the Adarkar Wastes; a war beast attacks and first mate Meida dies.
timeline.quote: though first mate Meida lost her life in the scuffle.

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn are arrested in Mercadia, Sisay, Hanna and Orim strike a deal with the Chief Magistrate to travel to Saprazzo for the Power Matrix.
timeline.quote: After the arrest of Gerrard , Tahngarth , and Karn in Mercadia

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay recalls her mother saying angels sing their swords' names with each strike.
timeline.quote: angels sing their swords' names with each strike.

citation.text: Archangel (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The academy manipulates marriages between families strong in white mana, including the Capashen and Sisay's ancestors.
timeline.quote: the academy soon had almost complete control over who wedded whom

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "First Phase". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians launch a preemptive strike on project sites, killing thousands including Sisay's parents; Gerrard survives, carried to Jamuura by Karn.
timeline.quote: launched a preemptive strike against sites where the Bloodline project was taking place, killing thousands of people

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "End of the Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay asks to return to Mercadia City and a vizier says it is easy.
timeline.quote: I need to get back to Mercadia City," said Sisay.

citation.text: Blockade Runner (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard tells Sisay the ceremonial guards are disciplined but could not fight.
timeline.quote: They couldn't fight their way out of a broom closet, but they've got discipline.

citation.text: Ceremonial Guard (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Sisay run deeper into the mountain unwilling to leave without the Weatherlight and crew.
timeline.quote: Neither of them intended to leave Mercadia without the *Weatherlight* and its crew.

citation.text: Tremor (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay is restored, the Legacy recovered, and the Weatherlight sails for Dominaria.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* was sailing home to Dominaria.

citation.text: Tranquility (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Power Matrix is stolen and the women are framed; Cho-Manno finds the real thief too late.
timeline.quote: the Power Matrix was stolen shortly after their arrival, and the women were framed for the crime.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takara brokers a new deal: the crew will repair the Weatherlight for the magistrate in exchange for freedom; Sisay, Hanna and Orim head to Saprazzo for a needed artifact.
timeline.quote: Takara brokers a new deal with the magistrate

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The magistrate lets the crew keep the Weatherlight in exchange for a mission to Saprazzo for the Matrix.
timeline.quote: The magistrate agrees to allow them to repair and keep the Weatherlight, in exchange for using it on a mission of the magistrate's choice.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orim arrives riding the whale-like creature and heals the dying Sisay.
timeline.quote: She calls on both sides to put away their arms, and then she heals Sisay.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disguised as guards, the crew and Cho-Manno free Gerrard using a storm.
timeline.quote: The new guards are the rest of the Weatherlight crew, plus Cho-Manno.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The party is attacked by Deepwood ghouls on the way to Ouramos.
timeline.quote: they are attacked by Deepwood ghouls.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard defeats Volrath in a sword fight by attacking his weak side.
timeline.quote: Gerrard takes his chance and attacks the right, breaking through Volrath’s defenses, felling him.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Sisay are pulled aboard the Weatherlight, which Karn now controls through its engine.
timeline.quote: Now a rope comes down and Hanna and Tahngarth pull the two up on board.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With hostages held, the Mercadians force Hanna, Sisay and Orim to retrieve the Power Matrix from Saprazzo, then steal it and murder its guardians.
timeline.quote: the Mercadians betrayed them again, stealing the artifact and murdering its guardians while attempting to frame Orim

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebels storm the Subterranean Hangar and destroy the Phyrexian fleet; the Weatherlight is reclaimed.
timeline.quote: they destroyed the Phyrexian fleet assembled in preparation for the coming invasion of Dominaria

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay jokes that Squee turned out a good shot.
timeline.quote: Who knew he'd be such a good shot?

citation.text: Zap (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion begins and Sisay helms Weatherlight in many battles until it crashes when the Primeval Dragons attack.
timeline.quote: Sisay stood at the helm of Weatherlight during many battles against the Phyrexian fleets

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Urza and Karn merge to complete the Legacy, defeating Yawgmoth; Weatherlight sinks near Urborg, leaving Sisay without a ship.
timeline.quote: leaving Sisay adrift without a ship to captain

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year after the Invasion, Karn takes Orim back to Mercadia, and Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee receive a new vessel named Victory.
timeline.quote: which she named Victory

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay crashes the Predator into Crovax's stronghold.
timeline.quote: I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold.

citation.text: Hull Breach (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Predator attacks the Weatherlight; Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Sisay crashes the Predator into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth duels with Greven il -Vec and kills him

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay discovers the Weatherlight's mirrored hull can be used defensively.
timeline.quote: Sisay discovered that the mirrored hull of the *Weatherlight* could be used as a defensive weapon.

citation.text: Captain's Maneuver (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A year later Freyalise erects a monument, and Karn, as an accumulation of the Legacy, takes Orim to Mercadia while Sisay, Squee and Tahngarth sail on the Victory.
timeline.quote: One year later, in a ceremony attended by survivors from all over the globe

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight enters Rath's atmosphere to rescue Sisay, led by Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Skyship Weatherlight entered its dangerous atmosphere far above the desert of deadly flowstone

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rescue party frees Karn and Tahngarth, but the 'Sisay' they find is a shapeshifter.
timeline.quote: They successfully freed Karn and Tahngarth

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard realizes Rath is absorbing Dominaria, then defeats Sisay and Takara set against him by Volrath.
timeline.quote: Gerrard realized that Rath was absorbing Dominaria itself.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay, Orim and Hanna arrive in Saprazzo seeking the Power Matrix; Sisay is wounded after a sailor harpoons a Breaker and Orim heals her.
timeline.quote: only to be saved by Orim, who called for peace and used her healing abilities to restore her captain.

citation.text: "Saprazzo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The vizier tells the myth of Ramos but postpones deciding about the Matrix.
timeline.quote: the vizier hesitated, postponing the decision.

citation.text: "Saprazzo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lahaime stages his own execution to feed the Mercadians false intelligence; the crew gets safe passage back to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Lahaime staged his own "execution" before Oustrathmer

citation.text: "Saprazzo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the Phyrexian Invasion nears completion, the Stronghold is the prison of Captain Sisay and later other Weatherlight crew; the crew loses Mirri, Ertai and Crovax.
timeline.quote: the Stronghold was the prison of Captain Sisay and later other members of the Weatherlight crew.

citation.text: "Stronghold (location)", section "On Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight is absorbed in the completed Legacy; Dominarians grant Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee a new ship, Victory.
timeline.quote: which Sisay named Victory

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Weatherlight's Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A cabin boy stowaway aboard a Suq'Ata ship turns out to be Sisay.
timeline.quote: a cabin boy who turns out to be none other than Sisay

citation.text: "The Secrets of Magic", section "Burning Vengeance , by Chris Pramas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay remarks on the aim of dim-witted mutants.
timeline.quote: For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim.

citation.text: Flametongue Kavu (Friday Night Magic 2005, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hanna sees unsettling unanimity among slivers and urges Sisay to keep the ship at a distance.
timeline.quote: she urged Sisay to keep the ship at a safe distance.

citation.text: Sinew Sliver (Planar Chaos, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke tells Sisay that he knows the Legacy is the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes and that its pieces were stolen from the child Gerrard.
timeline.quote: I know it to be the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke reveals that the sidar's son is alive and called Volrath, and that he knows where Volrath is and how much of the Legacy he holds.
timeline.quote: I also know he is alive and now called Volrath.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke names his price for the information: his daughter.
timeline.quote: "My daughter," Starke answered.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: In Benalia, Pol Cordel tells Gerrard that a Talruum has arrived aboard a flying ship, and Gerrard guesses Sisay has come for him.
timeline.quote: "You think she's come looking for me."

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke offers Maraxus the woman who knows where Gerrard is, claiming she can draw Gerrard from hiding, and Maraxus orders him to bring her.
timeline.quote: "Bring her," it said suddenly.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth tells Gerrard they came to find him because something terrible has happened to Sisay.
timeline.quote: something terrible has happened.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Sisay tells Tahngarth she has agreed to help rescue Starke's daughter from Volrath in exchange for information about the Legacy.
timeline.quote: This servant, Volrath, is holding Starke's daughter prisoner.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Sisay predicts that Gerrard will never be free of the Legacy.
timeline.quote: He'll never be free of the Legacy. He just doesn't know it yet.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke betrays Sisay by opening a portal at Volrath's command, from which massive hands drag her away.
timeline.quote: She was alone with the traitor, alone against Volrath's power, directed at her by Starke.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Sisay is abducted through the circle, and Starke leaves Volrath's abduction note beside her ring and flees the ship.
timeline.quote: Starke shivered as he put Volrath's abduction note on the table with Sisay's ring.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke decides to seek allies after learning Gerrard is no longer aboard the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: It's time I sought allies.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke recalls how Maraxus forced him to help take Sisay prisoner, yet Volrath and Maraxus still refused to free him or his daughter.
timeline.quote: He had gained nothing by betraying Sisay

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke admits he killed Maraxus to stop him exposing the betrayal of Sisay, and offers to lead Gerrard to Rath for his daughter's freedom.
timeline.quote: I can lead you to Rath,

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Sisay asks to fly higher out of a storm.
timeline.quote: Fly us higher, out of its storm.

citation.text: Waterspout Djinn (Duel Decks: Jace vs. Chandra, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay is reassured by Gerrard that her ship is intact.
timeline.quote: Intact," Gerrard reassured her, "which is more than I can say for you, my friend.

citation.text: Fugue (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jhoira reveals she knew Shanna's ancestor Captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: I knew your ancestor, Captain Sisay. I see you carry her sword.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: In the afterlife, Salvation, taking Sisay's form, explains that it protected Squee's soul and offers him a choice of returning or passing on.
timeline.quote: Or you can walk through this threshold, and your soul will finally be returned to the aether.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Sisay rejects Urza's plan to shatter the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Captain Sisay rejected this, declaring it madness

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay, searching for the Legacy, meets Rathi fugitive Starke, who offers information.
timeline.quote: Captain Sisay encountered a Rathi fugitive named Starke

citation.text: "Abduction of Sisay", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke betrays Sisay, orchestrating her capture through a planar portal and delivering her to the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: he orchestrated her capture through a planar portal and delivered her to the Stronghold

citation.text: "Abduction of Sisay", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay's capture baits Gerrard to Rath, fracturing and then reuniting the crew and recruiting Ertai.
timeline.quote: to bait Gerrard Capashen

citation.text: "Abduction of Sisay", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay takes the Weatherlight to the Wastes and recovers the Juju Bubble after fighting a mech.
timeline.quote: recovered the artifact after a fight with a mech leftover from the Brothers' War

citation.text: "Adarkar Wastes", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath's horrors descended on the manor and the Weatherlight crew joined the battle.
timeline.quote: As Volrath’s horrors descended upon the manor

citation.text: "Attack on Crovax's Estate", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath taunts Gerrard with mind-controlled Sisay and Takara; Gerrard defeats them.
timeline.quote: Gerrard defeated them

citation.text: "Dream Halls", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4204 AR the Weatherlight crew passed the Furnace of Rath as one of many hurdles on the way to Sisay.
timeline.quote: the Furnace of Rath were one of the many hurdles the crew had to surpass to reach their captain, Sisay

citation.text: "Furnace of Rath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay and Tahngarth visit the city abandoned for thirty years and find a survivor who points them toward the Juju Bubble.
timeline.quote: who pointed them in the direction of the Juju Bubble

citation.text: "Oneah", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aged ten, Squee saves Captain Sisay from his tribe, is exiled, and joins the Weatherlight crew as cabin boy.
timeline.quote: Squee saved Captain Sisay from his tribe and was exiled in response

citation.text: "Squee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay, Hanna, Orim and Takara-Volrath strike a deal for a stay of execution for Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn in exchange for obtaining the Power Matrix from Saprazzo.
timeline.quote: They obtained a stay of execution and relocation to better quarters for the three prisoners

citation.text: "Tower of the Magistrate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: Tahngarth (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
